set.body:
Conditions: reviewed source graph supplied vs automatically acquired graph (separates source
understanding from recall assessment). Frozen development comparison on the fixed Sherlock
populations, then held-out on a second FilmFestival film. Criterion pre-registered before any
outputs are read: more matching resolutions with no more wrong ones; report false-attribution
rate, abstention and correct-detail recovery separately. Spend requires owner authorization.

Acceptance: frozen pre-registration committed before launch; all requests retained, none
stitched across runs; bounded verdict recorded.
set.title: [evidence-binding S6] Two-condition frozen and held-out evaluation of binding
